M: The new hotel looks incredible, Sarai. You did an excellent job working with the general contractor during the construction process. Now let's discuss the complimentary shuttle service we'd like to offer between the hotel and the airport.
W: Right. I think guests will really like a free shuttle given how expensive cab rides to the airport are. Taking our shuttle will save them quite a bit of money. And it'll draw more guests to our hotel.
M: Agreed. Could you look into how many drivers and vehicles we'd need in order to provide this service?

M: I'm Ivan Pavlov — owner of Bounce Toy Shop. You left a message that you'd like to meet because you plan to write a news article about my store?
W: Yes — given that your shop is a local business, we want to include it in a future issue of the paper.
M: I'm grateful for the opportunity. Our grand opening is next week, but you can interview me and tour the store before that. Maybe tomorrow at noon?
W: That works! Is it OK if I bring a camera?
M: Yes, of course! There's just one area of the store I'd ask you to avoid taking pictures of. It's still being set up.

M: Yes, I'm still considering which activities to go with.
W: Why not call the city's tourism office? They'll have some good suggestions. And they can probably arrange for group rates.
M: Good idea. I'll do that right now.

M: So-Hyoon, welcome to the cast of Into the Dusk.
W: I'm thrilled but also nervous — I haven't performed in a musical of this scale before.
M: Don't worry. Even though it's a big production, you'll find a wonderful sense of community here.
W: That's good to hear. Oh, and is next month's rehearsal schedule available yet? I only have the one for this month.
M: We just finalized it — let me get you a copy.
W2: Sorry to interrupt, but can I take So-Hyoon's measurements?
M: So-Hyoon, this is Shreya, our costume designer.
W: It's nice to meet you, Shreya. Would you like to take the measurements here or somewhere else?

W: Oh, that's perfect for my family. But I'm concerned about the dents in the driver-side door.

W: Thursday is two days from now.

W: OK. What model do we need?

W: OK. I'll call now to make sure the pool supply store has the part in stock. Can you drop by the store later today to pick it up?
M: Sure. That way I can install the new filter tomorrow morning.
